title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: SailPoint Identity Security Cloud
providers.scope_notes: Covers SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (SailPoint Human Fabric). SaaS tenant (docs now branded SailPoint Human Fabric); VA is customer-hosted; no plan gating found for these token controls.

controls.name: accessTokenValiditySeconds
controls.what: Sets how long each issued bearer token lives (PAT default 43200s).

controls.name: Scopes
controls.what: Select scopes to narrow access below the user level; UI default is a no-authorization scope, API default is sp:scopes:all.
controls.setting: Scopes checkboxes on PAT / API client forms

controls.name: Delete API client (Bulk Delete)
controls.what: Delete API clients on the API Management tab or via DELETE /oauth-clients/{id}.
controls.setting: Admin > Global > Security Settings > API Management > Bulk Delete

controls.name: API client enabled flag
controls.what: OAuth client objects carry an enabled flag that can be patched.

controls_unknown: Any org setting to disable PAT creation or require approval for PATs/API clients
Any admin-enforced maximum PAT lifetime (API states no upper limit on expirationDate but the doc only says this, not that no policy exists)
Whether Network Settings IP/geo restrictions apply to /oauth/token or API calls
Whether deleting a PAT or API client invalidates already-issued bearer tokens (scope changes do not affect existing bearer tokens)
Audit event names for PAT/API client create, use, delete (published sample list is partial and lists none)
Whether API read calls (search, list identities) produce audit events
Whether disabling the owning identity stops its PATs
VA key lifetime, rotation and use logging

authentication.summary: An admin creates an API client (client ID and secret) under API Management. The client calls /oauth/token with the client credentials grant and gets a JWT with no user context.

federation.details: Client credentials tokens are issued without user involvement, so no IdP sign-in occurs.

ip_restriction.boundary: Network Settings (CIDR network definition, country allow/block lists) restrict sign-in per identity profile and are skipped under SSO. Docs do not say they apply to /oauth/token or API calls.

lifetime.summary: Client secret: no documented expiry; per-client accessTokenValiditySeconds

renewal.summary: Holder reuses the client secret to get new access tokens.

administration.summary: Created in Admin > Global > Security Settings > API Management or POST /oauth-clients; API default scope is sp:scopes:all. Clients have an enabled flag and can be bulk deleted.
administration.conditions: sp:oauth-client:manage; Support/Services accounts cannot create via UI

offboard.details: Docs say API keys (client credentials) are not tied to a specific person.

inventory.details: Admin > Global > Security Settings > API Management lists all API clients (also GET /oauth-clients).

token_format.notes: JWT bearer; OAuth 2.0 client IDs are UUIDs with dashes.

log_sources.name: Search > Events (events index, POST /search)
log_sources.notes: Kept one year plus current month; older up to 5 years via support request.

anomaly_cues: PATs or clients with sp:scopes:all or no expiry
lastUsed on stale tokens (updated once a day)

containment.steps: Delete via API Management Bulk Delete or DELETE /oauth-clients/{id}; or PATCH enabled=false.
containment.notes: Not documented whether issued access tokens die at once.

calls.rate_limit: 100 req / 10s per client_id per API version

calls.reveals: Identities, access, events; searchAfter pages past 10,000
